import json, subprocess, sys, copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
import pipeline

RUN = ['/app/submit/run']
def run(reqs):
    data = '\n'.join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs) + '\n'
    p = subprocess.run(RUN, input=data.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=120)
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr[:1000])
    return [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]

base = json.load(open('/app/examples/sample.image.json'))
mapped = json.load(open('/app/examples/mapped.image.json'))

def mut(name, fn):
    img = copy.deepcopy(base)
    fn(img)
    return (name, img)

cases = []
cases.append(mut('drop status', lambda i: i.pop('status')))
cases.append(mut('extra key', lambda i: i.update({'zzz':1})))
cases.append(mut('status error', lambda i: i.update({'status':'error'})))
cases.append(mut('cuts short', lambda i: i.update({'cuts':[0,32,64,96]})))
cases.append(mut('cuts bad last', lambda i: i.update({'cuts':[0,32,64,96,127]})))
cases.append(mut('cuts nonmono', lambda i: i.update({'cuts':[0,32,64,96,96]})))
cases.append(mut('cuts start', lambda i: i.update({'cuts':[1,32,64,96,128]})))
cases.append(mut('drop node', lambda i: i['stages'][1].__setitem__('nodes', [])))
cases.append(mut('extra node', lambda i: i['stages'][1]['nodes'].append(copy.deepcopy(i['stages'][1]['nodes'][0]))))
cases.append(mut('node prefix wrong', lambda i: i['stages'][1]['nodes'][0].__setitem__('prefix','2001:db8::/32')))
cases.append(mut('noncanonical node prefix', lambda i: i['stages'][1]['nodes'][0].__setitem__('prefix','2001:0db8::/32')))
cases.append(mut('node depth wrong', lambda i: i['stages'][1]['nodes'][0].__setitem__('prefix','2001:db8::/33')))
cases.append(mut('rule hop wrong', lambda i: i['stages'][0]['nodes'][0]['rules'][0].__setitem__('hop', 8)))
cases.append(mut('rule removed', lambda i: i['stages'][0]['nodes'][0]['rules'].pop()))
cases.append(mut('rule duplicated', lambda i: i['stages'][3]['nodes'][0]['rules'].append({'prefix':'2001:db8::1/128','hop':9})))
cases.append(mut('rule misplaced', lambda i: i['stages'][0]['nodes'][0]['rules'].append({'prefix':'2001:db8::1/128','hop':9})))
cases.append(mut('rule noncanonical', lambda i: i['stages'][3]['nodes'][0]['rules'][0].__setitem__('prefix','2001:db8:0:0:0:0:0:1/128')))
cases.append(mut('rule hop range', lambda i: i['stages'][3]['nodes'][0]['rules'][0].__setitem__('hop', 70000)))
cases.append(mut('edge child oob', lambda i: i['stages'][0]['nodes'][0]['edges'][0].__setitem__('child', 5)))
cases.append(mut('edge child neg', lambda i: i['stages'][0]['nodes'][0]['edges'][0].__setitem__('child', -1)))
cases.append(mut('edge prefix wrong', lambda i: i['stages'][0]['nodes'][0]['edges'][0].__setitem__('prefix','2001:db9::/32')))
cases.append(mut('edge removed', lambda i: i['stages'][0]['nodes'][0]['edges'].pop()))
cases.append(mut('edge extra', lambda i: i['stages'][0]['nodes'][0]['edges'].append({'prefix':'2001:db8::/32','child':0})))
cases.append(mut('used bits wrong', lambda i: i.update({'used_bits':[320,192,192,191]})))
cases.append(mut('used bits len', lambda i: i.update({'used_bits':[320,192,192]})))
cases.append(mut('peak wrong', lambda i: i.update({'peak':{'num':1,'den':2}})))
cases.append(mut('peak not reduced', lambda i: i.update({'peak':{'num':10,'den':128}})))
cases.append(mut('peak zero', lambda i: i.update({'peak':{'num':0,'den':1}})))
cases.append(mut('peak den zero', lambda i: i.update({'peak':{'num':5,'den':0}})))
cases.append(mut('capacity too small', lambda i: i.update({'capacities':[100,4096,4096,4096]})))
cases.append(mut('capacity changed', lambda i: i.update({'capacities':[8192,4096,4096,4096]})))
cases.append(mut('max_stride small', lambda i: i.update({'max_stride':16})))
cases.append(mut('stages len', lambda i: i['stages'].pop()))
cases.append(mut('stage extra key', lambda i: i['stages'][0].update({'x':1})))
cases.append(mut('node extra key', lambda i: i['stages'][0]['nodes'][0].update({'x':1})))
cases.append(mut('edge extra key', lambda i: i['stages'][0]['nodes'][0]['edges'][0].update({'x':1})))
cases.append(mut('rule extra key', lambda i: i['stages'][0]['nodes'][0]['rules'][0].update({'x':1})))

reqs = [{'op':'lookup','image':img,'addresses':['2001:db8::1','::']} for name,img in cases]
res = run(reqs)
fails=0
for (name,img), r in zip(cases,res):
    if r != {'status':'invalid'}:
        fails+=1
        print('EXPECTED invalid:', name, '-> got', str(r)[:160])
print('bad-image tests: %d cases, %d unexpected' % (len(cases), fails))

# valid images must be accepted
good = [
  ('sample', base),
  ('mapped', mapped),
]
res = run([{'op':'lookup','image':img,'addresses':['2001:db8::1','::']} for name,img in good])
for (name,img), r in zip(good,res):
    print(name, r if r.get('status')!='ok' else 'ok')
